reviews.text: It’s amazing for a pot concealer. Because of the brusg I think I’m using less product than I would using my finger. No product gets stuck in the bristles which also means less waste. It’s easy to use and works great under the eyes or for spot concealing. I definitely recommend buying it!!
reviews.zh: 用嚟掃罐裝遮瑕膏非常好。因為刷頭嘅關係，我覺得用嘅產品比用手指少。產品唔會卡喺刷毛入面，亦都代表浪費少啲。易用，喺眼睛底下或者局部遮瑕都好好用。我絕對推薦買！！

reviews.text: This brush makes it so easy to cover blemishes. Just tap on some pot concealer and you’re good!
reviews.zh: 呢支刷令遮蓋瑕疵好容易。只需要拍少少罐裝遮瑕膏就搞掂！

reviews.text: very nice and soft, dosent absorb product and packs my concealer well and blends it beautifully
reviews.zh: 好好、好軟，唔會吸走產品，又可以令我嘅遮瑕膏附著得好好，暈開效果都好靚。

reviews.text: The corrector & concealer brush 482 works like magic with my concealer. So easy to work on my dark spots and blends the concealer seamlessly. Highly recommended!
reviews.zh: Corrector & concealer brush 482 配合我嘅遮瑕膏，效果好神奇。用嚟處理我嘅色斑好容易，遮瑕膏暈開得完全冇痕跡。極力推薦！

reviews.text: 본 제품은 저랑 맞지 않는 거 같습니다. 본 제품은 블랙헤드 브러쉬로 활용해야 할꺼 같습니다.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好似唔啱我。呢款好似應該拿嚟當黑頭刷用。

reviews.text:
I love this brush! It’s fantastic at blending cream, balm and liquid products! It conceals marks, under eyes smoothly and even fill out areas with more visible pores like sides of nose perfectly! It’s also good quality & feels soft on the skin. 🤩

This brush is small & compact but feels well built with the body not staining easily and all parts feels tightly adhering together. The hairs of the brush are well assembled, tightly packed but just enough to leave some softness for buffing and blending. The hair material feels both soft and thick which makes it hard to discern if it is synthetic or natural, though, I think it’s synthetic. The brush came with a small plastic cover which adds to the more quality/luxury feeling.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢支刷！用嚟暈開膏狀、膏霜同液體產品都好好！可以遮蓋痕跡，眼底都順滑咁遮，就連鼻翼兩側呢啲毛孔比較明顯嘅位置，都可以填得好靚！質素都好好，皮膚觸感軟。🤩

呢支刷細細支、體積小，但手感好結實，刷身唔易染色，所有部件都緊緊黏埋一齊。刷毛組合得好好，排得好密，但又啱啱好保留到少少柔軟度，用嚟掃勻同暈開都好。刷毛嘅物料，軟同厚，令人好難分辨係人造定係天然，不過我諗係人造。刷子附有一個細細嘅膠蓋，令人覺得更有質感／奢華感。

reviews.text: The Studio17 Concealer Brush is amazing! It blends concealer seamlessly, giving me a smooth, flawless finish every time. The bristles are soft yet firm enough to provide great precision, especially around the eyes and nose. It feels high-quality and works well with both liquid and cream concealers. Highly recommend this brush for anyone looking to up their makeup game!
reviews.zh: Studio17 遮瑕刷超好！每次都可以將遮瑕膏暈開得完全冇痕跡，令我嘅妝容順滑、完美無瑕。刷毛軟，但又夠硬，精準度好高，特別係眼睛同鼻子周圍。感覺係高質嘅產品，配合液體同膏狀遮瑕都好好。想提升化妝水平嘅人，我極力推薦呢支刷！

reviews.text: Brush blends concealer perfectly on small spots without making it look too unnatural!! I use the wakemake define concealer with this brush and it is a lovely combo <3 Also the brush comes with a brush cover which is a huge plus if you’re traveling or take it with you for touch ups! :)
reviews.zh: 呢支刷喺細細嘅位置暈開遮瑕膏都好完美，又唔會令個妝睇落太假！！我用 wakemake define concealer 配呢支刷，係一個好靚嘅組合 <3 另外，呢支刷仲附有刷套，如果你旅行或者想帶住去補妝，呢點就係一大優點！:)
